name: Taming the Beast
summary: In the Gustberry Lowlands, Quel'ana Quickgale asks you to tame a galestrider. Your skill on open ground will prepare you for trials ahead.

sections.title: Across the Plains
sections.body: You've already shown you can tame the river's crawler. Now Quel'ana Quickgale gives you a Taming Rod and sends you to the lowlands of Zephras. There, a proud, winged galestrider runs swiftly across the plains. Earn its trust and practice your skill. Then bring the rod back to Quel'ana in Valanaar.

faq.q: What does Quel'ana want me to tame?
faq.answer: Quel'ana asks you to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands.

faq.q: Where do I find the galestrider?
faq.answer: You can find the Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands, in the plains of Zephras.

faq.q: What is the Taming Rod for?
faq.answer: Quel'ana gives you the Taming Rod so you can tame an Ornery Galestrider.
Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar asks you to tame an Ornery Galestrider and bring back the Taming Rod.
